item.title: End-of-session summary table for auto runs
item.intent: When an auto session ends — by draining the backlog, hitting --limit, or tripping the circuit breaker — users receive a formatted summary showing exactly what happened: items attempted, passed, failed, total duration, and lines changed.
item.description: auto done ends with a single log line ('N items complete') that discards all the session data already being tracked. A formatted summary table — printed just before the terminal bell (FEAT-030) — gives users an at-a-glance record of the session without needing to scroll sprint logs. Data is already in-scope: items_completed, items_failed, session start time, and cumulative lines changed from result.json. This table is also the natural anchor for future --json output.
steps: At session end (drain, --limit, or circuit-breaker), collect: items_completed, items_failed, elapsed seconds, cumulative linesAdded and linesRemoved from each result.json
Print a formatted summary block: header line, then tabular rows for each stat, then a footer line
Include: Items attempted, Items passed, Items failed, Total duration (Xm Ys), Lines added, Lines removed
Summary fires on all exit paths: clean drain, --limit cap, and circuit-breaker failure
Add --no-summary flag to suppress the table for scripted/CI use
acceptanceCriteria: After auto done drains the backlog, a summary table prints showing counts, duration, and lines changed
Summary fires on --limit exit and circuit-breaker exit with appropriate header text
auto done --no-summary suppresses the table but does not suppress the completion message
All numeric totals are accurate (tested with a 2-item auto run)
